title: GLOSA foley (notation 2.0)
description: A one-shot sound-effect directive: the JSON object inside a Fountain note. It places a generated spot effect (a door slam, footsteps) on top of the ambient bed, starting where the note sits in the timeline. It plays once: it never loops and has no stop. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved. There is no notation 1.0 tag form.

prompt.description: Text prompt for the effect generator.

seed.description: Generation seed: an integer in 0...4294967295, or the same value as a decimal string.

take.description: Length in seconds of the generated take, played once. Default 5.

steps.description: Sampler steps. Default: the generator's default.

cfg.description: Guidance scale. Default: the generator's default.

offset.description: Seconds from the note's position in the timeline to the effect start; negative starts it earlier. Default 0.

fadeIn.description: Fade at the effect start, in seconds. Default 0.

fadeOut.description: Fade at the effect end, in seconds. Default 0.

output.description: Path of the take WAV. Assigned on first render.
